en: A black and white vintage postcard depicting a European street lined with ornate, historic buildings in late 19th or early 20th-century architectural style. There are people standing in coats and hats, a lamppost, and various shop signs in German. A sign on the corner building reads 'WENZL KLEMENT COND., OBLATEN-VERSAND'. Trees line the street, and there is an overall sense of affluence.
